from pathlib import Path
import json,re

tid='DEV-PRED-ASTRA-SLUG-STATE-DIAG-20261005'
state=Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'/f'{tid}.json'
if not state.is_file():
    print('DIAG_STATE=MISSING',flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(31)
obj=json.loads(state.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
blob='\n'.join(str(x) for x in (obj.get('operations') or []))
# The PASSed diagnosis printed the bounded contents of the prior details task/result files.
matches=re.findall(r'ASTRA_EXACT_SLUG=([^\s\\"]+)', blob)
matches=[m.strip() for m in matches if m.strip()]
uniq=sorted(set(matches))
print('ASTRA_SLUG_MATCHES='+json.dumps(uniq),flush=True)
if len(uniq)!=1:
    raise SystemExit(32)
slug=uniq[0]
print('ASTRA_EXACT_SLUG='+slug,flush=True)
print('AUTONOMOUS_MODEL_PROVENANCE_READY=true',flush=True)
